items.prompt: At M=1000000007, how should a fixed-width port protect a dot-product accumulator?

options.text: Use a 32-bit product, then cast its already-computed result.
options.why: The product can overflow before the later cast. Promotion must happen before multiplication.

options.text: Sum all twenty unreduced products in signed 64-bit.
options.why: Each product may approach 1e18, so a full unreduced sum can exceed the type range.

options.text: Convert every product to float to make it exact.
options.why: Float does not preserve every large integer product exactly.

options.text: Promote before multiplying; reduce each product-add.
options.why: A product of reduced factors plus one reduced accumulator fits the stated 64-bit bound.

items.explanation: A product of reduced factors plus one reduced accumulator fits the stated 64-bit bound.
